verdict.rationale: Ramp's open-source CLI is built for unattended use. `--no-input` disables prompts for CI, and `--agent` emits JSON for scripting (the default when piped). Standalone agents authenticate without a browser by exchanging OAuth client credentials (RAMP_CLIENT_ID/RAMP_CLIENT_SECRET), and RAMP_PROFILE pins an identity for automation. The docs explicitly target scripted and scheduled workflows and long-running background agents, backed by a sandbox default and a client-credentials Developer API for server-to-server automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI running in a real CI pipeline, and documented CI recipes (e.g. pipeline config examples).
